plan.title: Invite two named vendors to eRFX RFQ

steps.note: Open the eRFX project create screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage.
Apply the first available RFQ template before adding line items.
Add the requested CYLINDER product and set its quantity to 10.
Set the requested delivery location for the line item.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors from the product's vendor list.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Open the published RFQ stage's Participants tab.
Verify that exactly two vendors are participants after publishing.
